name: Speed, energy, transfer and void upgrades

pages.text: $(l)Choose the right behavior$()$pSpeed Upgrade — Reduces the ordinary processor duration according to the configured bonus.$pEnergy Upgrade — Reduces eligible process cost according to the configured discount.$pTransfer Upgrade — Actively exports finished items through permitted output faces.$pVoid Upgrade — Explicitly discards completed overflow when enabled. This is intentionally lossy.$pSpecial machine programs can have their own timing and energy rules; a visible upgrade slot does not mean every world action uses the ordinary process formula. The recipe reader labels its baseline calculations as before installed upgrades.$pTransfer throughput scales with upgrade count up to its configured cap. In the shipped settings each Transfer Upgrade contributes four items per transfer, with a cap of 64. These are defaults, not a substitute for the server configuration.$pObtain Speed Upgrades: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pObtain Energy Upgrades: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/automation)Transfer directions$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/blocked_output)Void and blocked output$()
